assistant:
On proposal **factory_bus11** (base plus a 3 MW factory at Bus 11, scheduled daily from 08:00 to 18:00), **yes**: it introduces violations during the week. The comparison covers 1–7 January 2000 at 15-minute resolution.

There are violations in **314 of 672** snapshots with the factory, versus **35** in the base case. In **279 snapshots**, the proposal violates limits when the base does not; there are no snapshots where the base violates and the proposal does not. The first proposal-only violation is at **08:00 on 1 January**.

The proposal’s worst values over the week are **0.868 p.u. minimum voltage**, **154.9% maximum line loading**, and **103.3% maximum transformer loading**. The affected elements include Bus 3, Bus 4, Bus 5, Bus 6, Bus 7, Bus 8, Bus 9, Bus 10 and Bus 11, as well as lines L0 and L1 and transformer T0.

The factory was modelled at **0.95 lagging power factor**; existing measured loads used the network’s **0.97** power-factor assumption.
